subtitle: Lesson 8 · A shaped window onto a live table

eyebrow: Why a view, not another table

steps.label: No storage of its own
steps.sub: Re-runs its SELECT every time something queries it

eyebrow: Aggregated to a real grain: subscriber + week
code:
CREATE VIEW marts.vw_finance_refunds AS
SELECT
  subscriber_id,
  DATE_TRUNC('week', updated_at) AS refund_week,
  COUNT(*) AS refund_event_count,
  SUM(refund_amount) AS total_refund_amount
FROM marts.refund_events
GROUP BY subscriber_id, DATE_TRUNC('week', updated_at);
caption: refund_event_count is a deliberate sanity-check column, not an afterthought.

eyebrow: A simpler weekly summary for a headline card
code:
CREATE VIEW marts.vw_finance_refunds_weekly_total AS
SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('week', updated_at) AS refund_week,
  COUNT(*) AS refund_event_count,
  SUM(refund_amount) AS total_refund_amount
FROM marts.refund_events
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('week', updated_at);
caption: Same underlying table, a coarser grain for Power BI's headline card.
